verdict.rationale: The on-device runtime (viam-server/RDK) is open source on GitHub and runs on your own hardware. A community report says you can run your own server and have robots talk to each other with no outside communication, and locally cached configs keep robots working offline. However, the same source says the cloud app is not open source, and fleet management, data sync and querying, ML training, and hosted apps are all described as Viam-cloud services, so the full product cannot be self-hosted. Missing for 10: a self-hostable cloud/control plane (fleet management, data, ML), first-party documentation of a fully self-hosted deployment, and hands-on corroboration of offline-only operation.
